noclipSpeed.description: Start speed: Speed level when noclip starts and after a wheel click.

noclipMaxSpeed.description: Highest speed: The mouse wheel stops at this level.

noclipStep.description: Wheel step: Level change per mouse wheel notch; also the lowest level.

noclipFast.description: Shift: Speed multiplier while Shift is held.

noclipFaster.description: Alt: Speed multiplier while Alt is held.

noclipSlow.description: Ctrl: Speed multiplier while Ctrl is held (below 1 slows down).

announceKind.description: Style: Colour and icon of the notification.

announceSeconds.description: Time on screen: Seconds the announcement stays.
